cloudPhysicalRenderer.scope: PHYSICAL_GVISOR_TEXT_EXTRACT_ONLY; no local sandbox expected; not signed durable application E2E

signedCloudExtractionToKnowledgeIndex.scope: single signed application pipeline on cloud Linux with official runsc; attachment upload, TEXT_EXTRACT operation, S3 readback hash, knowledge index READY and semantic marker search

assertions: injected extraction identity mismatch fails the new build
previous committed index version remains active and searchable
original quarantined delivery is requeued only after no-execution proof
fixture hashes restored
knowledgeFailedRebuildRetention.limitation: The injected failure used the isolated pre-extracted-text fixture; ACK-loss/redelivery of this specific index route is not a separate fault-injection receipt.

assertions: source document deletion through authenticated API removes search hits
a subsequent deterministic task has zero knowledge references
memory source revocation between recall and model admission is rejected by application test
knowledge source revocation between retrieval and model admission is rejected by application test
sourceRevocationNoRecall.limitation: The post-delete task used an isolated fixture after all active fixture copies of that source were absent; this does not prove every ACL revocation race against a live production corpus.

memoryExpiryAllCategories.limitations: Verifies database-clock transition behavior and audit for each category; not a long-duration wall-clock soak.

assertions: projection committed with epoch and summary hash
canonical conversation history hash unchanged before and after projection
same projection read after isolated API restart
unit coverage rejects over-limit required input, preserves whole tool pairs, and does not mutate canonical message list
source revocation is rechecked before model admission
contextProjectionDurability.limitation: No separate real-database cancellation or forced transaction-failure injection was run while a projection commit was in flight.

modelColdStartProcessRss.measurement: Java /proc/1/status VmRSS/VmHWM, distinct from Docker cgroup memory usage; one restart and deterministic local semantic query; container stayed healthy.
modelColdStartProcessRss.limitation: Sample is from the isolated local API process; it is not a cloud host-wide memory guarantee and does not claim physical co-residency with runsc.

assertions: synthetic SANDBOX ownership of the database-backed shared slot causes semantic search to reject before ONNX inference with HEAVY_RUNTIME_BUSY
the exact synthetic slot is released and returns idle
sharedHeavyRuntimeAdmission.limitation: This proves admission coordination, not simultaneous physical sandbox and full-service load; actual runsc signed extraction was exercised separately on the cloud host.

assertions: original R5 API/gateway/runner/worker container IDs remain running
health status is acceptable for each original service
R6.3 candidate runner is not running

remainingGates: final clean-main body/evidence package with hash-checked protected copies
privateArtifacts: Raw fixture credentials, DB data and runtime logs remain in ignored .cache/r63-local; do not publish them.
knownLimitations: Retrieval quality corpus is deliberately small (one real bilingual source plus synthetic unrelated rows); Hit@8 and scale timings are bounded fixture results.
Knowledge failed-build/old-active retention is demonstrated; a knowledge-route-specific ACK-loss/redelivery fault injection was not separately run.
Context projection persistence/restart and canonical-history stability are verified; cancellation-during-commit and forced database-transaction failure were not separately injected.
The shared heavy-slot gate is exercised synthetically; cloud runsc signed extraction is separately verified, not as simultaneous full-stack plus sandbox resource saturation.
The browser tested responsive CSS widths and a keyboard subset; true 200 percent zoom and complete accessibility review remain NOT_RUN.
R6.3 is not deployed and R6 has not been released; cloud production remains R5.

skillUpdates.summary: Added R6.3 confirmed lessons: cloud-only runsc, separate RSS/cgroup/host metrics, synthetic shared-slot claim boundary, bounded revocation/expiry evidence, projection restart/hash, headless zoom limitation, and automatic phase-closeout deduplication.
